episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Young American flyers arrive in war and discover that the bureaucracy is more deadly than the enemy.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Yossarian pursues desperate measures to get home, while Milo sees war as a growth industry.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Yossarian needlessly expends energy to avoid a feared mission; disaster catches up with him, when he least expects it.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: On a surreal trip, Yossarian begins to realize the magnitude and influence of Milo's business empire.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Reeling from one violent tragedy, Yossarian encounters incomprehensible darkness in Rome, and is faced with an impossible choice.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Alive and intact, Yossarian is thwarted by an old adversary. Confronted by a devastating loss, he undergoes a transformation.
